name: skill-analyzer
description: Sistem analisis modular lintas-domain dengan sepuluh spesialis inti dan lima engine. Menggunakan Agent Skills sebagai format portabel, adapter untuk OpenAI/Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, VS Code, dan Cursor, serta assurance berbasis evidence.

interface.longDescription: SKILL ANALYZER 1.0.0 mempertahankan sepuluh spesialis analisis inti dan lima cross-skill engine. Paket memakai struktur Agent Skills berbasis SKILL.md sebagai sumber instruksi kanonis, dengan panduan kompatibilitas dan exporter untuk OpenAI/Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, VS Code, dan Cursor. Adapter memetakan lokasi skill dan konteks host tanpa mengasumsikan bahwa tool-calling, sub-agent, persistensi, browsing, atau enforcement tersedia seragam. Evidence Registry, Residual Unknowns, Trace Graph, FIRE, Capability Readiness, Change Impact, Controlled Experiment, dan Information Authenticator tetap menjadi kontrol analitis inti.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this problem using the four-stage SKILL ANALYZER workflow: select methods, investigate causes, challenge risks, and engineer practical solutions.
Audit this framework critically: identify evidence gaps, root-cause weaknesses, failure modes, and testable improvements.
Stress-test this strategy and convert material findings into preventive controls, implementation steps, and evaluation criteria.
